what: When a section heading passes the screen center (both scrolling down and back up), the page background and text color change to that section’s colors over .3s linear. It is for About and Careers pages where the whole page tints as it moves from white sections to pink, ochre and sky-blue. If a section’s bottom edge passes the center and no next section exists, the color stays.

options.--fx-tone-bg: Background color of that section (via style or the using side’s css, skin variables and color-mix also work), default var(--kf-bg)
options.--fx-tone-ink: Text color of that section, default var(--kf-ink)
options.name: Name to write into the target’s data-tone when painting — for matching header button colors to the section color

note: If the element to be painted already has a transition, the two stack and it gets delayed — turn off the target’s background-color transition

from.where: shared.js section colors (original scroll-color module — applies bg and text from data-colors to body over .3s linear, start and end center)
